text:
anya: Quick heads-up — CloudMart agreed to a joint "demo day" for their marketplace launch. We need a playbook: launch post, benchmark narrative to cite, webinar + panel, and inbound lead routing. Who can own which piece?

sam: I can own the webinar org/MC + panelist coordination. Proposed date?

anya: Targeting 2 weeks from next Tue — tentative: 2026-04-07. That gives us ~10 business days. Tight but doable.

liz: I can take launch post + landing page. Need final hero metrics (latency/cost slices) and a short customer quote. Also SFDC mapping for the marketplace leads.

Tomas: I’ll take benchmark narrative + technical appendix. Need the exact workload we demo (multi-tenant reranking + embeddings lookup?). Also will coordinate with infra to get perf numbers.

neil: I’ll handle inbound routing + LeadOps flow. Who is the lead for CloudMart so I can map the partner attribution?

anya: CloudMart contact is @paul.c (they prefer partner_attribution=cloudmart_marketplace). We should set a campaign param so we can attribute marketing-sourced leads reliably.

liz: For the landing page, I want a sample blurb. Idea: "Redwood Inference + CloudMart: fast, reliable LLM inference in your cloud marketplace — <20ms tail latency on recommended tiers, 2–3x cost vs raw GPU baseline via caching + quantization." Thoughts?

sam: Good. For the webinar, panel: CloudMart PM, Redwood solutions engineer (neil?), and a customer (if we can secure one). 30–40 min demo + 20 min Q&A. I’ll draft moderator script.

Tomas: For benchmarks, prefer explicit test harness: 10k query corpus, mix 60/40 instruct/chat, seq len 512, 99th pct latency and token cost. I’ll publish a short table and include the harness link.

liz: Lead form fields: name, email, company, role, interest (POC/Trial/Buy), campaign=cloudmart_marketplace, lead_source=cloudmart_demo_day. Can we auto-tag partner?

neil: Yep. We’ll add a webhook to marketing automation. Sample mapping snippet for ops team: `{
  "campaign": "cloudmart_marketplace",
  "lead_source": "marketplace",
  "partner": "CloudMart",
  "origin": "demo_day_webinar"
}`

neil: Also creating SFDC lead assignment rule: Marketplace leads -> SDR team queue -> tag "partner:cloudmart".

anya: Can marketing-bot auto-create the calendar and a draft landing page in Contentful?

marketing-bot: Calendar event "CloudMart x Redwood — Demo Day" created for 2026-04-07 10:00-11:30 PT. Draft landing page created: /content/cloudmart-demo-day-draft. Assigned to liz and tomas.

sam: Timeline checklist (brief):
- Today: webinar date confirm, partner speaker confirm (sam)
- +2 days: landing page draft (liz), benchmark draft (tomas)
- +4 days: finalize assets + run perf tests (infra + tomas)
- +6 days: rehearsals + speaker brief (sam + neil)
- +8 days: email invite + ads live (liz)
- Day-of: monitor stream, have fallback demo + model variant ready (neil)

liz: I’ll prototype the hero + CTA today and drop in the draft link. Need the benchmark numbers by EOD Thursday.

Tomas: Running the harness now — will ping infra to lock a machine config (A100, q4). Expect first pass numbers in ~36 hours.

neil: For fallback policies: if primary model exceeds latency SLO we route to quantized variant and add a banner to the demo page noting temporary degradation. Also prepare a short statement for comms.

anya: Great. Owners recap: sam (webinar & speaker ops), liz (landing + launch post), tomas (benchmarks + appendix), neil (lead routing + runtime fallback). I’ll own partner comms and the email copy.

sam: One ask — surface two short benchmark callouts for the launch post: 1) 99th-pct latency at 512 tokens; 2) end-to-end cost per 1k tokens vs baseline. Tomas, can you provide both?

Tomas: Yes. I’ll include the test harness URL and a short methodology blurb: "internal harness, open metrics, reproducible steps."

liz: Also want a short FAQ for marketplace listing (billing, VM config, privacy). I’ll draft and post for review.

marketing-bot: Reminder: Please tag tasks with #cloudmart-demo in Jira.

anya: Okay team — next sync tomorrow 09:30 PT. If any blockers earlier ping here. :thumbsup:

sam: 👍

liz: 👍

Tomas: on it

neil: added SFDC rule draft to the repo (ops/lead-rules/cloudmart).

anya: Perfect. Closing thread for now — will reopen if partner requests changes.
